name: cloudflare-worker-version-routing
description: Call individually addressable Cloudflare Worker versions over HTTP from another Worker.

scripts.cf-typegen: wrangler types workers/caller/env.d.ts --config workers/caller/wrangler.jsonc --strict-vars false && wrangler types workers/target/env.d.ts --config workers/target/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface TargetEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.cf-types:check: wrangler types workers/caller/env.d.ts --config workers/caller/wrangler.jsonc --strict-vars false --check && wrangler types workers/target/env.d.ts --config workers/target/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface TargetEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --check
scripts.typecheck: npm run cf-types:check && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.deploy:dry-run: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config workers/target/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config workers/caller/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry-run
